relationship_controls: LPB and Matkator are recorded in AWESWELL board/accounting material as directly controlled wholly-owned Spanish subsidiaries.
Pink and Hava Vida were incorporated with Patricia Isabel Domínguez Montelongo as sole shareholder.

Gil Marer states that Patricia held the Pink and Hava Vida shares for the benefit of AWESWELL LIMITED / Sun Rock; the legal effect of that beneficial-interest position remains a separate proof question.
Legal personality, registered ownership, beneficial/economic interest and platform membership must remain separate fields.

solos.transaction: Proposed acquisition of 100% of the target and subsidiaries, linked to signed commercial distribution agreements.
solos.payment_mechanism: Signed exclusivity terms provided for Net Payments from the commercial agreements to accumulate in escrow and, on completion, to be set off against the purchase price.
solos.outcome: Sun Rock did not complete the acquisition. Gil attributes the failure to the Spanish events affecting the wider Sun Rock matter.
solos.later_history: The Solos business was acquired by a third party in April 2019; the old target later became Arnloft 2002 Limited, entered members' voluntary liquidation and was dissolved in 2023.
solos.damages_use: Preserve transaction documents, professional work and payment architecture as contemporaneous evidence and potential damages material, subject to causation, valuation and double-counting controls.
